entries.name: Chosen Undead
entries.description: The player character who journeys through Lordran, defeats powerful beings, and determines the fate of the Age of Fire.

entries.name: Gwyn, Lord of Cinder
entries.description: A lord who kindled the First Flame, extending the Age of Fire at great cost.

entries.name: First Flame
entries.description: The primordial fire that ushered in the Age of Fire; it fades over time, threatening the world with Dark.

entries.name: Link the Fire
entries.description: An act of sacrifice to rekindle the First Flame and prolong the Age of Fire.

entries.name: Firelink Shrine
entries.description: A central hub in Lordran where the Chosen Undead meets allies, kindles bonfires, and begins their journey.

entries.name: Anor Londo
entries.description: A grand, radiant city associated with the gods and the legacy of Gwyn.

entries.name: Undead Burg
entries.description: A ruined settlement crawling with hollows, often an early path for the Chosen Undead.

entries.name: Undead Parish
entries.description: An area above Undead Burg known for the Bell of Awakening and a prominent blacksmith.

entries.name: Blighttown
entries.description: A toxic, decaying shantytown that descends into the depths and disease of Lordran.

entries.name: Quelaag's Domain
entries.description: A lair beyond Blighttown where a Bell of Awakening can be rung after a deadly encounter.

entries.name: Sen's Fortress
entries.description: A deadly fortress of traps and guardians that tests those seeking the path to Anor Londo.

entries.name: Kiln of the First Flame
entries.description: A desolate place tied to the First Flame, where the final confrontation to determine the world’s fate occurs.

entries.name: Bonfire
entries.description: Rest points that offer safety and recovery but also restore many enemies when used.

entries.name: Estus Flask
entries.description: A healing flask replenished at bonfires, associated with the warmth of the fire.

entries.name: Lordvessel
entries.description: A great vessel used to open the way to powerful Lords by filling it with their souls.

entries.name: Lord Soul
entries.description: Immense souls discovered near the First Flame, wielded by ancient beings to shape the world.

entries.name: Andre of Astora
entries.description: A steadfast blacksmith in Undead Parish known for weapon reinforcement and craftsmanship.

entries.name: Giant Blacksmith
entries.description: A giant blacksmith who forges and modifies weapons in Anor Londo.

entries.name: Anastacia of Astora
entries.description: A Fire Keeper who tends the bonfire at Firelink Shrine and enables leveling through her power.

entries.name: Oscar of Astora
entries.description: A knight encountered early who sets the Chosen Undead on a path toward prophecy and purpose.

entries.name: Solaire of Astora
entries.description: A jolly knight devoted to the sun, known for his hopeful attitude and co-op summoning.

entries.name: Siegmeyer of Catarina
entries.description: A friendly knight often found pondering obstacles, known for his round armor.

entries.name: Knight Lautrec of Carim
entries.description: A knight with a dangerous reputation, whose actions can greatly affect Firelink Shrine.

entries.name: Crestfallen Warrior
entries.description: An undead at Firelink Shrine who offers bleak commentary and guidance.

entries.name: Kingseeker Frampt
entries.description: A primordial serpent who urges the Chosen Undead to place the Lordvessel and link the fire.

entries.name: Darkstalker Kaathe
entries.description: A primordial serpent who supports the rise of Dark and an alternative to linking the fire.

entries.name: Bell of Awakening
entries.description: Great bells that, when rung, set major events in motion and open the way forward.

entries.name: Asylum Demon
entries.description: A massive demon encountered in the Undead Asylum, often one of the first major trials.

entries.name: Taurus Demon
entries.description: A towering demon fought on a battlement in Undead Burg.

entries.name: Bell Gargoyles
entries.description: Stone guardians fought near the first Bell of Awakening.

entries.name: Capra Demon
entries.description: A fast, brutal demon fought in a cramped arena.

entries.name: Gaping Dragon
entries.description: A grotesque dragon-like creature encountered in the Depths.

entries.name: Chaos Witch Quelaag
entries.description: A powerful being guarding the second Bell of Awakening in Quelaag's Domain.

entries.name: Iron Golem
entries.description: A giant guardian fought atop Sen’s Fortress, blocking access to Anor Londo.

entries.name: Ornstein and Smough
entries.description: A deadly duo fought in Anor Londo; their defeat is a major turning point.

entries.name: Seath the Scaleless
entries.description: A pale dragon who sought immortality, associated with sorcery and twisted experiments.

entries.name: Bed of Chaos
entries.description: A chaotic entity born from the attempted recreation of the First Flame.

entries.name: Gravelord Nito
entries.description: A Lord of Death associated with disease, decay, and the dead.

entries.name: Four Kings
entries.description: A group of powerful beings tied to the Abyss and the fate of New Londo.

entries.name: Gwyn (Boss Encounter)
entries.description: The final confrontation in the Kiln of the First Flame against Gwyn, Lord of Cinder.

entries.name: Warriors of Sunlight
entries.description: A covenant associated with the sun and cooperation; Solaire is closely tied to it.

entries.name: Chaos
entries.description: A force born from the failed attempt to recreate the First Flame, tied to demons and Lost Izalith.

entries.name: Age of Fire
entries.description: An era defined by the power of the First Flame and the rule of the gods.

entries.name: Age of Dark
entries.description: An era associated with the fading of the First Flame and the rise of Dark.
